Its light wooden construction makes it convenient to take onto a boat.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 3 |durability = 10 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Fisherman's Shield}} Fisherman's Shields are semi-rare [[Shield]]s, similar to the [[Hunter's Shield]]. They are often carried by fishermen for their [[Fish]] design, which is said to represent hope for a great catch. This is aided by their light wooden construction, which makes them easier to take onto a boat. There are five areas where a Fisherman's Shield can be found. Two are in [[Lurelin Village]]. One is near [[Tawa Jinn Shrine]] in the [[Rabella Wetlands]]. Another is in a [[Treasure Chest]] in an enemy camp north of [[Parache Plains]]. There is also in a Treasure Chest on a cliff near [[Brynna Plain]] on the shores of [[Lanayru Bay]]. Finally, [[Selmie]] gives one out as a reward for completing the [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] between 2:45 and 3:00.{{Cite|A shiny new record deserves a shiny new shield. Here y'go!|Selmie|BotW}} Being made of wood, Fisherman's Shields will burn to a crisp if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s like metal Shields would. Finally, they cannot be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_032" |Life = 10 |GuardPower = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 5 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 12 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 3 |durability = 10 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Fisherman's Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Fisherman's Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} == See Also == {{See Also| * Selmie's Spot * Shield * Wooden Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Shields |items= BotW, TotK }}
